Medical Treatment Treatment of hypothyroidism
consists of administration of exogenous thyroid hormone to 
supplement or replace endogenous thyroid hormone produc-
tion, with one exception. If hypothyroidism is caused by iodine
deﬁ ciency, it can be remedied through adequate intake of 
dietary iodine.1, 62
Clinical beneﬁ ts of either treatment begin in three to ﬁ ve days 
and level oﬀ  after four to six weeks. Patients should be moni-
tored for signs and symptoms of over treatment (tachycardia, 
palpitations, nervousness, tiredness, headache, increased excit-
ability, sleeplessness, tremors, possible angina).62
